import math
ok={'A':lambda t:math.tan(t/2),'B':lambda t:math.cos(t/2),'C':lambda t:1/math.tan(t/2),'D':lambda t:math.sin(t/2)}

import sympy as sp
t=sp.symbols('t')
sol=[s for s in sp.solve(sp.Eq(10*sp.sin(t)**2+6*sp.cos(t)**2,7),t) if 0<s<sp.pi/2]
r=sp.simplify(sp.tan(sol[0]))
opts={'A':1,'B':sp.sqrt(3),'C':sp.Rational(1,2),'D':1/sp.sqrt(3)}
assert sp.simplify(r-opts['D'])==0
for k in 'ABC': assert sp.simplify(r-opts[k])!=0
